q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
The earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026. Today is August 23, 2026. That's 3 days until the earnings announcement when new forward guidance will be provided.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

NVIDIA has already issued forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue of **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (range: $89.2B to $92.8B). This guidance was provided in May 2026 during their Q1 earnings release.

The question asks what the forward guidance will be "in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release" on August 26, 2026. This appears to be asking what NEW guidance NVIDIA will provide at that time - likely for Q3 FY2027 revenue (the quarter after Q2).

However, interpreting the question literally: if it's asking whether the **existing** Q2 FY2027 guidance of $91.0B will change by the August 26 release, that's unlikely. Companies rarely revise guidance downward before the quarter ends unless there's a material change. Since we're only 3 days from the earnings date, and the guidance explicitly assumes no China Data Center revenue (a conservative assumption), NVIDIA would only revise if there was a major negative development.

Given the strong sequential growth trajectory (Q1 FY2027 up 20% sequentially to $81.6B), continued AI demand, and no material negative announcements in recent news, the guidance is more likely to be reaffirmed or potentially exceeded than revised downward.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**

- Major negative macro shock or AI market disruption in the final 3 days
- Unexpected geopolitical sanctions impacting demand
- Major customer cancellations or order reductions
- Supply chain crisis affecting shipments
- These are low probability given the short timeframe and stable recent environment

**(d) What would push the value higher?**

- If the question is asking for NEW guidance for Q3 FY2027, the base case would assume continued sequential growth from the $81.6B Q1 actual toward the $91.0B Q2 guidance range
- Strong demand momentum could support guidance above the midpoint or even above the range
- The Wall Street analyst consensus of $91.9B (slightly above the guidance midpoint) suggests some upside potential
- Potential upside to the existing Q2 guidance if the assume-zero-China scenario changes

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6B
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0B ± 2% ($89.2B - $92.8B)
- Sequential growth from Q1 to Q2 guidance: +11.5% (from $81.6B to $91.0B)
- Wall Street consensus for Q2: $91.9B

Historical precedent from the data: NVIDIA has been exceeding analyst expectations in recent quarters, with the Q1 actual of $81.6B aligning with what appeared to be strong execution.

---

## Interpretation Challenge

The question is ambiguous. It could mean:
1. **What will the Q2 FY2027 guidance be when revised/reaffirmed on Aug 26?** → Likely $91.0B ± 2% (already issued, probably reaffirmed)
2. **What will the Q3 FY2027 forward guidance be (issued at Q2 earnings)?** → This requires forecasting the next quarter's outlook

Given the range provided (99.5B to 115.5B), this is well above the existing Q2 guidance of $91.0B ± 2%, suggesting the question IS asking for Q3 FY2027 guidance to be issued on August 26.

### If forecasting Q3 FY2027 guidance:

From Q1 ($81.6B) to Q2 guidance ($91.0B) was ~+11.5% sequential growth. Assuming similar or slightly moderated growth from Q2 actual (likely ~$91B) to Q3:
- Conservative (8% sequential growth): ~$98.3B
- Base case (11-12% sequential growth): ~$101-102B  
- Optimistic (15% sequential growth): ~$105B

The range bounds of 99.5B-115.5B bracket this expectation reasonably well.

**My point estimate for Q3 FY2027 guidance:** Given the sustained AI momentum, data center demand, and NVIDIA's recent execution, I estimate guidance in the low-to-mid $102-105B range, with the midpoint around $103B.

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).

For Q1 FY2027, which ended April 26, 2026, NVIDIA reported record revenue of \$81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% sequentially. Data Center revenue also hit a record \$75.2 billion, up 92% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).

NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued in May, is \$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook explicitly assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This guidance implies a range between \$89.2 billion and \$92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 revenue is approximately \$91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA also guided for GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points, for Q2 FY2027 [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).
